Resume advice by occupation

How to Write a Resume for Your Profession

Choose your field to see the experience, skills, metrics, credentials, and achievement examples recruiters expect in that kind of resume.

TechnologyProduct and Program ManagementFinanceMarketing and SalesAdministration and OperationsCustomer ServiceCreativeEducationHealthcareEarly CareerEngineering and ConstructionLogistics and TransportationSkilled TradesHospitality

Use the guide as a framework.

Each profession values different evidence. A nurse needs clear licensure and clinical scope. A software engineer needs systems and production outcomes. A sales representative needs quota, segment, and pipeline context.

Keep every claim true. Replace the sample numbers and bullets with your own work, then tailor the first half of the resume to the job description.
